svg.text: Thirteen biomes at dawn: the world-light tints on the ground, trees and water

The sky is the game's dawn key (teal into rose into apricot, cooler and greener than the sunset); each biome's ground, rock, vegetation and water take that key's world-light multiply (data/art/sky.json), and the keyline stays. The fighters' auras and bodies
are never dimmed: under each panel, the worst aura and body distance to any of that biome's tones at this key (rule 20 and 15). Same strips, same seeds as the noon sheet.
